m: महा—यागिक m. pl. N. of a school of the Sāma-veda, Divyāv.
महा—याम n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.

महा—या˚नाभिधर्म-संगीति-शास्त्र n. N. of wk.
महा—यान n. ‘great vehicle’ (opp. to हीन-य्˚), N. of the later system of Buddhist teaching said to have been first promulgated by Nāgārjuna and treated of in the Mahā-yāna-sūtras, MWB. 66; 158-160 &c.
महा—यान m. ‘having a gr˚ chariot’, N. of a king of the Vidyādharas, Kathās.
महा—यान—देव m. an honorary N. of Hiouen-thsang, Buddh.

महा—यान—प्रभास m. N. of a Bodhisattva, ib.
महा—यान—सूत्र n. N. of the Sūtras of the later Buddhist system, MW.
महा—यान—सूत्र-रत्न-राज m. N. of a highly esteemed Mahā-yāna-sūtra, Kāraṇḍ.
महा—यान—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
महा—यान—सम्परिग्रह-शास्त्र n. N. of wk.
महा—यान—योग-शास्त्र n. N. of wk.
महा—यात्रा f. a great pilgrimage, the pil˚ to Benares, MW.
N. of wk.
महा—यात्रिक m. N. of a man, Hāsy.
महा—यौधाजय n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.

of a learned man, Cat.
महा—यशस् f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, MBh.

m: महा—यज्ञ m. a great sacrifice or offering, a principal act of devotion (of these there are 5 accord. to Mn. iii, 69-71, viz. ब्रह्म-, देव-, पितृ-, मनुष्य-, and भूत-यज्ञ; cf. IW. 194 &c.; RTL. 411), ŚBr. &c. &c.
N. of Viṣṇu, MBh.
pl. (with पञ्च) N. of wk.
महा—यज्ञ—भाग-हर m. ‘receiving a share of the gr˚ sacr˚’, N. of Viṣṇu, MBh.
महा—यज्ञ—क्रतु m. = महायज्ञ above, Cat.
महा—यक्षी f. a gr˚ female Yakṣa, R.

m: महा—यक्ष m. a gr˚ Yakṣa, a chief of the Y˚, R. (cf. यक्ष-पति)
N. of the servant of the second Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī, L.
pl. a class of Buddhist deities, MW.
महा—यक्ष—सेना-पति m. a general of the gr˚ Yakṣa
N. of a Tantra deity, Buddh.
महा—यम m. the gr˚ Yama, AV.
महा—यमक n. a verse in which all four Pādas contain words with exactly the same sounds, but different senses (e.g. Kir. xv, 52 or Bhaṭṭ. x, 20).
महा—यन्त्र n. a gr˚ mechanical work, MBh.
महा—यन्त्र—प्रवर्तन n. the engaging in or erecting gr˚ mech˚ works, Mn.
महा˚यस (˚हाय्˚) mfn. having much iron (as an arrow which has a large point, Nīlak.), MBh.
महा—यति m. a gr˚ ascetic, MārkP.
महा—यव m. a kind of large barley, L.
महा—योग-पञ्चरत्ने आश्वलायनोपयोग्याधान-प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
महा—योगेश्वर m. a gr˚ master of the Yoga system, MBh.
महा—योगिन् m. a gr˚ Yogin (N. of Viṣṇu or of Śiva, esp. when worshipped by Buddhists, MWB. 215), MBh.
a cock, L.
महा—योनि f. excessive dilation of the female organ, ŚārṅgS.; Suśr. (अति-म्˚).
महा˚युध (˚हाय्˚) mfn. having great weapons (said of Śiva), MBh.
महा—युद्ध n. a gr˚ fight, MBh.

महा—युग n. a gr˚ Yuga or Y˚ of the gods (= 4 Yugas of mortals or the aggregate of the Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara and Kali Yugas = 4, 320, 000 years; a day and a night of Brahmā comprise 2, 000 Mahā-yugas), Sūryas. (IW. 178).
महा˚युत (˚हाय्˚) m. or n. (?) a partic. high number, Buddh.
